avis.texte: This was a cute mask set. It has a cooling sensation under the eyes

I bought these last week and they are the best eye patches I've ever used! They literally stuck to my face like an under eye tattoo, I barely even noticed they were on, they felt so amazing! I love them so much!
I like these patches better than the gel ones....plus they're cute.
These eye patches are great for gifting. I bought them to add to the baskets for my friends & family. Also, grabbed one for myself. They were soothing.

avis.titre: These are great for slumber party
avis.texte: I buy these under eye patches for slumber parties, and the girls love them. And I love that they're learning about skin care. It's such a young age. They can carry this through their lives.

I received a free Hello Kitty & Friends Hydrogel Under Eye Patches from BzzzAgent and Hello Kitty in exchange for my honest review. First of all, the Hello Kitty-adorned package is lovely. But these patches are much more than just adorable. When you use them, they immediately feel calming and cooling. After only one application, my under-eye region appeared more awake and rejuvenated, and I could see a difference in puffiness and dark circles. Additionally, unlike some others I've tried, they stick well and don't fall off. The serum is moisturizing and light, and it even made my makeup apply more smoothly. I really adore how they add a little fun to self-care. These are ideal if you're unwinding before bed or simply need a little boost. I would absolutely buy it again and suggest it to anyone looking to add a little kawaii charm to their undereye area!
Loved the cute design! They stayed in place well and felt soothing on. I think my under eyes looked a bit smoother when I took them off.
It was nice and hydrating. Good for prep under makeup or just for self care!

avis.titre: Like it..don't know if I love it
avis.texte: I feel like the packaging on this product is super cute! As for the product I just don't feel like I could see much of a difference. It has a cooling almost Like tingly feeling to me, so kind of relaxing but that's it. I would recommend someone try it for themselves but I don't really see myself going out of my way to buy

avis.titre: Hello Kitty & Friends Hydrogel Under Eye Patches
avis.texte: I used these before bed one night. They were very relaxing but I don't know if they really helped to reduce any puffiness. It would be something fun to do at a girls night or kids sleepover!

avis.titre: Super cute and leaves skin soft
avis.texte: These are super cute and have adorable packaging. They left me skin feeling good and soft. They would make a great gift also. I would use them again.
I love this product. It helped get rid of the shadows under my eyes. I will be buying more of this product.

What I like most about these eye patches are the hyaluronic acid to help add hydration to a part of my face that is difficult to keep smooth and moisturized. Additionally, the caffeine provides added benefits for depuffing!
These undereye patches are not only cute, they're effective! My undereye appeared more awake & fresh after application.

These feel super cooling and refreshing on the skin and didn't cause any irritation to my sensitive skin. Plus they're super cute and made my self care day feel extra luxurious! I would by then again, but maybe in a multipack.

This is a rather gimmicky product that's great for Hello Kitty fans. I put the eye patches on and my partner gave me one look and said it would be awful if the decals were left as tattoos. They are cute and playful but the packaging is a lot of plastic and from an eco-friendly standpoint I feel better using my eye roller. They contain caffeine and are moisturizing especially during the allergy seasons when puffy eyes come out. I found them cooling and a nice treat but they don't work miracles. Overall they are on par with most products like this I have used before.
I really enjoyed using these hydrogel eye patches! They are so cute and effective as well! My underyes appeared brighter, smoother, and more hydrated! Highly recommend!
I used these as night patches and they stayed on super well. I liked the serum soaked into the patches and do think they lessened the visibility of my dark circles.

've tried my fair share of under eye treatments, but these depuffing patches genuinely impressed me. The cooling sensation kicks in instantly, and within about 15–20 minutes, my under-eye area looked noticeably smoother and more refreshed. The puffiness was significantly reduced, and I looked way more awake—even after a short night's sleep. What I love most is how gentle they are. No irritation, no sticky residue—just a nice hydrated finish that works well under makeup too.

I honestly didn't expect to fall in love with under-eye patches, but these totally changed the game! First of all, the packaging is *adorable*—I mean, who wouldn't smile seeing Hello Kitty on their skincare shelf? But beyond the cuteness, these patches really deliver. They feel instantly cooling and soothing the moment you apply them. I noticed a difference in puffiness and dark circles after just one use—my under-eye area looked more refreshed and awake. Plus, they stick well and don't slide off like some others I've tried. The serum is lightweight but hydrating, and my makeup even went on smoother afterward. I also love that they make self-care feel a little more fun. Whether you're relaxing before bed or just want a quick pick-me-up, these are perfect. Would definitely repurchase and recommend to anyone who wants to pamper their under eyes with a touch of kawaii charm! 💖✨

I love these under-eye masks! They feel cool and refreshing as soon as I apply them. After using them, my eyes look less puffy, brighter and more refreshed. I have sensitive skin and haven't had any redness or irritation while using them, which is a huge plus! The quality is excellent—the masks are durable and don't tear or break when applying. The size is just right for the under-eye area, covering well without feeling too big or too small.
These felt cooling, but were nothing special. I don't know that I like Hello Kitty enough to purchase again.

Love the hello kitty obviously and I felt it worked great on me I felt my skin fresh and radiant
Super cute under eye patches that not only look pleasing to the eye but also work effectively!!

avis.titre: Super cute and soothing, but not a miracle worker
avis.texte: I bought these mostly because of the adorable Hello Kitty packaging, but I was pleasantly surprised by how nice they felt on my skin! The hydrogel texture is really cooling and soothing — perfect for mornings when my under-eye area feels puffy or tired. They stay in place pretty well and leave my skin feeling refreshed and lightly hydrated. That said, I didn't notice any dramatic difference in dark circles or fine lines, so if you're expecting big skincare results, these might not be the go-to. But as a relaxing pick-me-up (and a super cute one at that), they're definitely worth it. I'd buy them again, especially as a fun self-care treat.
This is the best and cutest under eye patches. It did wonders for my puffy under eyes and redness

avis.titre: Cutest Way to Refresh Tired Eyes!
avis.texte: I recently tried the Hello Kitty & Friends Hydrogel Under Eye Patches, and honestly, I'm impressed. First off, the packaging is ridiculously cute, major bonus. But beyond the aesthetics, the patches feel super refreshing on the skin. I put them on straight out of the fridge, and within 15 minutes, my under-eye area looked noticeably less puffy. They stayed in place well and didn't leave any weird residue. Not a miracle product, but a really nice pick-me-up, especially on tired mornings. Would definitely repurchase.
Came soaked in serum. It is thin but moisturizing. It is shaped properly for the under eyes. Love.
These felt great. They were very hydrating. They were not at all irritating. Seem high quality.

I was pleasantly surprised by the eye patches. I made sure to use it on a day where I was most tired. After removing the patches I felt that I looked less tired and more awake than I felt. I didn't experience and sensitivity to the product and there wasn't a strong scent. I would gladly purchase again.

These under eye patches are super cute and easy to put on. However, I felt like that didn't do much for my under eye area. They felt cool which would be nice to use at the end of a hot day either morning or afternoon skin care regime in the summer.

These are amazing! The only negative thing I can say is I need more! They're hydrating and soothing and I felt they really helped my tired eyes feel awake. I would definitely buy these and recommend them to my friends!

The Depuffing Hydrogel Under Eye Patches with Hyaluronic Acid and Caffeine by The Crème Shop are such a treat! They instantly refreshed my under-eye area and made me look more awake and well-rested. Plus, the adorable Hello Kitty design adds a fun and playful touch to my skincare routine.

Amazing product, just love it, goes very well sensitive skin, love the design so funny to put it on under eyes, OMG, the way it works just amazing, all the puffness under the saggy eyes will gone in just 15 minutes, this patches become A must product on my cosmetic bag, Thank you little cute kitty eye patches, of forget to mention, the cooling effect from the just is just outstanding

Super cute design and refreshing feel as soon as you apply them. Great for morning use to soothe tired eyes. The essence is light, absorbs quickly, and doesn't leave any sticky residue. While it doesn't dramatically reduce dark circles, it definitely makes the under-eye area look more awake. Bonus points for the adorable packaging—perfect as a fun little gift!
